description: Full deterministic security audit of an AI-agent session record (25 checks, three-level verdict: verified / unverified / unknown, per-check evidence). Provide the record as {profile, responses}, or as {session: {profile, responses}}, or as {question: "<session record JSON string>"}. Never include passwords, private keys, seed phrases, or production credentials — such input is rejected before execution.

profile.description: Agent profile object of the session record.

question.description: Session record as a JSON string (same form as the HTTP checkup endpoint).

responses.description: Responses object of the session record, keyed by check id.

name: moyan_checkup
